plugins.name: lior-skills
plugins.description: Agent skills by Lior Pesoa: design-crit (a design critique of rendered web and iOS screens with an annotated crit page), ugc-video (UGC video ads with an AI avatar over real screen recordings), delegate (plan and review while cheaper subagents write the code), migrate-to-fable-5-2 (move prompts and agent setups to Claude Fable 5.2, following Anthropic's prompting guide) and cv-interview (interview someone about their career and write a CV that holds only what they told you).
